answer: Every submission could be committed with a unique work hash before finality. The hash binds the identity, epoch, required words, and full text, so an identical answer cannot be silently reused by another key. Auditors publish knoll, saffron, and basalt commitments and compare them across the ledger; duplicates are rejected before rewards settle. A farmer must generate a distinct coherent response for every account and defend it under review. The basalt from idea to reward is auditable, making mass copying expensive. Work tag 0fdswp9 binds this text to one identity.
